newsitem.title: USA: IXC readying consent offer to sell debt - sources.
newsitem.headline: IXC readying consent offer to sell debt - sources.

text.p: IXC Communications Inc is preparing to ask the consent of its current bondholders to issue more debt to finance capital expenditures, according to market sources.

The company is currently restricted from issuing more debt by convenants in its outstanding bonds. IXC would presumably pay bondholders an additional fee in order to receive their permission, sources added.
The company has selected Credit Suisse First Boston as the consent solicitation agent and the underwriter of a new junk bond deal if bondholders agree to the plan, sources said.
The size of the new debt offering has not been determined but is expected to be on the order of "a couple of hundred million (dollars)," one market player said.
Calls to the company were not immediately returned.
IXC, based in Austin, Texas, is building a digital long-distance telephone services network.
As of May, the company had $285 million in 12.5 percent senior notes due '05 outstanding.
